rows.what_the_ink_shows: The final three lines of the Proposition visibly contain Cependant, a struck elle, then cette fonction n'est pas bornée / dans la boule unité de l^1, et n'est par / suite pas une fonction entière de lambda. The negation pas before une fonction entière is present, and entière is followed by de and a clear lambda. Inspected the full scan and enlarged crop crops/1_scan120_L1197_conclusion.jpg.
rows.note: The manuscript reads as the original transcription; retain its stated inference from unboundedness on the unit ball to not being entire. The supplied correction calls this the author's slip and instead asserts that S is entire on l^1 while unbounded on the unit ball, citing an integral representation and local boundedness. Those mathematical claims are attributed to the supplied table and were not checked in this visual transcription pass.
rows.event_type: used and rechecked in this run
rows.event_outcome: Compared the original Proposition conclusion to the full scan and tight enhanced crop. Confirmed both the unboundedness wording and the explicit negative conclusion pas une fonction entière. No edit and no mathematical proof check.

additional_events.type: carried as background without fault found
additional_events.outcome: The supplied correction table asserts that S is entire on all of l^1 but unbounded on the unit ball, citing S(x)=integral_0^infinity exp(-t) product_i(1+t x_i) dt as giving local boundedness everywhere and rejecting the manuscript's inference in infinite dimension. This mathematical assertion is carried with attribution only; the integral representation, local boundedness, and entireness were not proved or independently checked here.
